private func nagramiXSelectByAuthorIcon(_ color: UIColor) -> UIImage? {
    // UIKit coordinates keep the person and the badge upright at every scale.
    let format = UIGraphicsImageRendererFormat()
    format.opaque = false
    return UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 24, height: 24), format: format).image { renderer in
        let context = renderer.cgContext
        context.setStrokeColor(color.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(1.55)
        context.setLineCap(.round)
        context.setLineJoin(.round)
        context.strokeEllipse(in: CGRect(x: 4.2, y: 2.2, width: 6.4, height: 6.4))
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: 1.8, y: 20.4))
        context.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 13.0, y: 20.4), control1: CGPoint(x: 1.8, y: 10.9), control2: CGPoint(x: 13.0, y: 10.9))
        context.strokePath()
        context.saveGState()
        context.setBlendMode(.clear)
        context.fillEllipse(in: CGRect(x: 12.2, y: 12.2, width: 11.2, height: 11.2))
        context.restoreGState()
        context.strokeEllipse(in: CGRect(x: 13.2, y: 13.2, width: 9.2, height: 9.2))
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: 15.6, y: 17.9))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 17.2, y: 19.5))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 20.1, y: 16.4))
        context.strokePath()
    }
}
